BEGIN;

-- ==========================================================
-- EMPRESAS QUE SERÃO APAGADAS COMPLETAMENTE
-- ==========================================================
CREATE TEMP TABLE _empresas_apagar (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY
) ON COMMIT DROP;

INSERT INTO _empresas_apagar (id)
VALUES
    (6),
    (7),
    (10),
    (11);

-- ==========================================================
-- CONFERÊNCIA ANTES DE APAGAR
-- ==========================================================
SELECT
    id,
    nome,
    telefone,
    assinatura,
    cnpj_cpf,
    created_at
FROM empresas
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
ORDER BY id;

-- ==========================================================
-- APAGAR DADOS DE E-MAIL
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM email_attachments
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM email_messages
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM email_accounts
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- BILLING / ASAAS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM billing_asaas_events
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- CHAT INTERNO
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM chat_read_state
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM chat_eventos
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- DISPAROS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM disparos_destinatarios
WHERE disparo_id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM disparos
    WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
);

DELETE FROM disparos
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- PINS / PARTICIPANTES DE ATENDIMENTO
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM atendimento_pinned_conversas
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM atendimento_participantes
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- CHATBOT
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM chatbot_configs
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- PIVÔS DE INSTÂNCIAS / FILAS / DEPARTAMENTOS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM departamentos_instancias
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM filas_instancias
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- MÍDIAS
-- Precisa apagar antes de mensagens, grupos e clientes.
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM midias
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   OR instancia_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM empresas_instancias
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR cliente_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM clientes
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR grupo_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM grupos
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR mensagem_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM mensagens
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR mensagem_grupo_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM mensagens_grupo
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   );

-- ==========================================================
-- MENSAGENS 1:1
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM mensagens
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   OR cliente_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM clientes
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR instancia_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM empresas_instancias
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR atendimento_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM atendimentos
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   );

-- ==========================================================
-- MENSAGENS DE GRUPO
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM mensagens_grupo
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   OR grupo_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM grupos
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR instancia_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM empresas_instancias
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   );

-- ==========================================================
-- ATENDIMENTOS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM atendimentos
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   OR cliente_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM clientes
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   )
   OR instancia_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM empresas_instancias
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   );

-- ==========================================================
-- GRUPOS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM grupos
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   OR instancia_id IN (
        SELECT id
        FROM empresas_instancias
        WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
   );

-- ==========================================================
-- CLIENTES
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM clientes
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- FILAS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM filas_atendimento
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- DEPARTAMENTOS - auxiliares
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM departamentos_membros
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM departamentos_acl
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- PERMISSÕES DE COLABORADORES
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM colaboradores_permissoes
WHERE colaborador_id IN (
    SELECT id
    FROM colaboradores
    WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar)
);

-- ==========================================================
-- COLABORADORES
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM colaboradores
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- USUÁRIOS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM usuarios
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- SETORES
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM setores
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- DEPARTAMENTOS
-- Primeiro remove hierarquia para não travar no parent_id.
-- ==========================================================
UPDATE departamentos
SET parent_id = NULL
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

DELETE FROM departamentos
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- INSTÂNCIAS WHATSAPP
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM empresas_instancias
WHERE empresa_id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- POR ÚLTIMO: EMPRESAS
-- ==========================================================
DELETE FROM empresas
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

-- ==========================================================
-- CONFERÊNCIA FINAL
-- Se retornar vazio, apagou.
-- ==========================================================
SELECT
    id,
    nome,
    telefone,
    cnpj_cpf
FROM empresas
WHERE id IN (SELECT id FROM _empresas_apagar);

COMMIT;

1 - Comercial
2 - Financeiro
3 - Suporte
